title: US Midterms 2026
description: Live results for the US midterm elections: all 435 House seats, 35 Senate races and 36 governors, called race by race, with the balance of each chamber, your state's races and maps.
eyebrow: US midterm elections · election day Tue Nov 3, 2026

dates.hours: state by state; the first polls close at 6 pm Eastern in parts of Indiana and Kentucky and the last at 1 am Eastern in Alaska

lede: Every House, Senate and governor's race as the counts come in: the balance of each chamber, the races in your state, maps, the closest contests and how the night moved.
intro: All 435 House seats are up, 35 of the 100 Senate seats (the 33 regular seats plus the Ohio and Florida specials) and 36 governorships. A House majority is 218 seats and a Senate majority 51; a 50–50 Senate is run by the Vice President's tie-breaking vote. Seats not up this year count toward each party's total. There is no compass for this election: this page only follows the results.

note.text: Results and race calls come from civicAPI, an independent feed that reads state and county counts. Everything is unofficial until each state certifies its count in the weeks after election day; a race civicAPI has not called is shown as leading, not won.
